name: file-trail
description: Shows which file each Read, Edit and Write touched (Glob and Grep too, where the build has them as tools), with the time and whether it was blocked, in a side pane, the status line and a local file.

dir.title: Trail folder
dir.description: Folder for one trail file per session. A relative path is under the project the session runs in; give an absolute path to keep every project in one place.
